fact: The BCLCC reported yearly complaints and court referrals: 556 complaints and 32 referrals in 2020, 2056 and 38 in 2021, 3028 and 33 in 2022, 3678 and 55 in 2023, 4114 and 63 in 2024.
title: Burkina/Cybercriminalité : 4 114 plaintes enregistrées en 2024, un préjudice financier de plus de 1 700 000 000 FCFA
